Interface Connection<Self extends Connection<Self>>

Type Parameters:
Self - The implementing interface of this interface
All Superinterfaces:
CommandSource, DataHolder<Self>
All Known Subinterfaces:
Connection.Changing, Connection.Writable
public interface Connection<Self extends Connection<Self>> extends DataHolder<Self>, CommandSource
A players client, specifically the connection of the client

Note: Unlike in Mojang's Minecraft where the "Player" is both an entity and connection. In Cyrus these are different and should be treated as such.
